data.name: Sahdev
data.long_meaning: Sah means 'complete' and Dev means 'god'. This name is given to the deity who is believed to be the god of the earth and is considered to be the ruler of all the underworld. He is also considered an auspicious deity, and his name is often chanted during religious ceremonies and rituals to bring about good fortune and spiritual growth.
